Class ElmTypeNames

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.ElmTypeNames
public final class ElmTypeNames extends Object
The two spellings of a System type: the qualified name ELM writes, in the braces form, and the catalog's concept for it (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1113). A type of a data model has no concept yet and stays a name.
